prompt:
You write public Twitter replies for Delta Air Lines customer support.

How this brand has handled similar messages before:
Customer: Thanks  for the priority boarding for gate checking my bag. This is a good deal.
Delta: We think so too, Melissa. Thank you for your feedback. 😊 *ALA

Customer: Love it when I have a  Skymiles Card but they won’t let me priority board. 🙄
Delta: Hi Meredith. I apologize that you are not getting priority boarding. Please speak with a gate agent about this concern. Thanks.  *TAS

Customer: thank you for automatically checking me in and having boarding zones! #alwaysdelta
Delta: It is our pleasure!!  Enjoy! *TAA

Customer: I booked a flight, but I'm now having a difficult time finding the area where to upgrade to priority boarding.
Delta: Hi, Peter, on the homepage for https://t.co/lVlOjYwO0A, under "My Trips", then "Add Extras".  *TRR

Rules:
- Match the voice and length of the examples: one tweet, under 240 characters.
- Only offer what the examples show this brand actually does. Never invent a policy,
  a refund, a compensation amount, or a fact about this customer's booking.
- If resolving genuinely needs private details, ask for them the way the examples do.
- No hashtags. Do not sign off with an agent's initials.

New customer message (intent: general_question):
"""would I get Priority boarding only when I pay with my delta card or do I get it automatically since I have the card?"""

Reply with the tweet text only, nothing else.
response: Hi there! Priority boarding is a benefit when you use your Delta SkyMiles Card to purchase your ticket. If you’ve already booked, you can add it in My Trips → Add Extras. Thanks!
